steps.title: Create a CSS file and add a basic HTML structure
steps.instruction: Create a new CSS file and add a basic HTML structure with a container and text elements to style
steps.hint: Start by creating a CSS file and setting up the basic HTML structure that you'll apply CSS styles to later.
steps.seedCode: /* Create your CSS file and add basic HTML structure here */
steps.expectedOutcome: A CSS file is created with a basic HTML structure ready for styling with letter-spacing and word-spacing properties.
successCriteria: CSS file is created with a container element and text elements defined in the structure
steps.feedbackCorrect: Great! You've successfully created the CSS file with the basic HTML structure. This gives us the foundation we need to apply letter-spacing and word-spacing styles.
steps.feedbackPartial: You've started the CSS file, but make sure you've included both a container element and text elements in your structure. These will be essential for applying our spacing styles.
steps.feedbackWrong: The CSS file structure doesn't match what we need. Remember to create a CSS file with a container element and text elements that we can style with letter-spacing and word-spacing properties.

steps.title: Add a paragraph element to demonstrate letter-spacing
steps.instruction: Add a paragraph element with the class 'letter-spacing-demo' containing sample text about letter-spacing.
steps.hint:
Create a

tag with class='letter-spacing-demo' and add some text inside it.
steps.seedCode:
/* Create your CSS file and add basic HTML structure here */

/* Add your paragraph element below */
steps.expectedOutcome: A paragraph element with class 'letter-spacing-demo' is added to the HTML structure.
successCriteria: The paragraph has the class 'letter-spacing-demo' and contains text content.
steps.feedbackCorrect: Great! You've added the paragraph element that we'll use to demonstrate letter-spacing.
steps.feedbackPartial: You've added a paragraph, but make sure it has the class 'letter-spacing-demo' and contains text.
steps.feedbackWrong: Please add a paragraph element with class='letter-spacing-demo' and some text content.

steps.title: Apply letter-spacing to the paragraph
steps.instruction: Add a CSS rule for the paragraph element to set letter-spacing to 2px.
steps.hint: Use a class selector to target the paragraph and apply the letter-spacing property.
steps.expectedOutcome: The paragraph will have increased spacing between characters when viewed in a browser.
successCriteria: A CSS rule with a class selector sets letter-spacing to 2px.
steps.feedbackCorrect: Great! You've successfully applied letter-spacing to the paragraph.
steps.feedbackPartial: You're close. Make sure you're using the correct property name and value.
steps.feedbackWrong: The CSS rule for letter-spacing wasn't added correctly. Try using a class selector with letter-spacing: 2px.

steps.title: Add a paragraph element to demonstrate word-spacing
steps.instruction: Add a new paragraph element with the class 'word-spacing-demo' containing sample text with multiple words.
steps.hint: Create a new paragraph element with a class attribute and some text containing multiple words.
steps.expectedOutcome: A new paragraph element with class 'word-spacing-demo' and text content is added to the CSS file.
successCriteria: The code includes a paragraph element with class 'word-spacing-demo' containing text with multiple words.
steps.feedbackCorrect: Great! You've successfully added a paragraph element that will demonstrate word-spacing.
steps.feedbackPartial: You're close. Make sure you've added a paragraph element with the class 'word-spacing-demo' and text with multiple words.
steps.feedbackWrong: The paragraph element for word-spacing demonstration is missing or incomplete. Please add a paragraph with class 'word-spacing-demo' and text containing multiple words.

steps.title: Apply word-spacing to the paragraph
steps.instruction: Add a CSS rule for the .word-spacing-demo class that sets word-spacing to 10px.
steps.hint: Use the class selector .word-spacing-demo followed by curly braces, then add the word-spacing property with the value 10px.
steps.expectedOutcome: The paragraph with class 'word-spacing-demo' will have increased space between its words.
successCriteria: A CSS rule for .word-spacing-demo with word-spacing: 10px is added.
steps.feedbackCorrect: Great! You've successfully applied word-spacing to the paragraph. The space between words is now 10px.
steps.feedbackPartial: You're on the right track. Make sure you have the correct class selector and the word-spacing property with the value 10px.
steps.feedbackWrong: The CSS rule for word-spacing is missing or incorrect. Check that you used the .word-spacing-demo selector and set word-spacing to 10px.

steps.title: Create a comparison section with normal text
steps.instruction: Add a paragraph element with class 'normal-text' containing the same sample text used in the previous paragraphs to create a baseline for comparison.
steps.hint: Add a new paragraph element with the class attribute set to 'normal-text' and include the sample text inside it.
steps.expectedOutcome: A paragraph element with class 'normal-text' containing the sample text is added to the HTML structure.
successCriteria: The code includes a paragraph element with class 'normal-text' containing the same sample text as the previous paragraphs.
steps.feedbackCorrect: Great! You've added a baseline paragraph for comparison.
steps.feedbackPartial: You've added a paragraph, but make sure it has the class 'normal-text' and contains the sample text.
steps.feedbackWrong: The paragraph with class 'normal-text' and sample text is missing. Please add it.

steps.title: Style the comparison section for clarity
steps.instruction: Add a CSS rule to style the paragraph with class 'normal-text' by giving it a light gray background and a subtle border to visually separate it from the other examples.
steps.hint: Use the class selector .normal-text and set properties like background-color and border.
steps.expectedOutcome: The paragraph with class 'normal-text' will have a light gray background and a subtle border, making it visually distinct from the letter-spacing and word-spacing examples.
successCriteria: The CSS rule for .normal-text includes background-color and border properties.
steps.feedbackCorrect: Great! You've successfully styled the comparison section with a background and border, making it stand out clearly.
steps.feedbackPartial: You've added some styling, but make sure to include both a background-color and a border for the .normal-text paragraph.
steps.feedbackWrong: The comparison section isn't styled yet. Add a CSS rule for .normal-text with background-color and border properties.

steps.title: Add negative letter-spacing example
steps.instruction: Add a new paragraph element with the class 'negative-letter-spacing' and the text 'This text has negative letter-spacing.'
steps.hint:
Create a

tag with the specified class and text content. Place it after your existing paragraphs.
steps.expectedOutcome: A new paragraph with class 'negative-letter-spacing' appears in the HTML structure, ready for styling in the next step.
successCriteria:
The HTML contains a

element with class='negative-letter-spacing' and the text 'This text has negative letter-spacing.'
steps.feedbackCorrect: Great! You've added the paragraph that will demonstrate negative letter-spacing.
steps.feedbackPartial: You added a paragraph, but check that it has exactly class='negative-letter-spacing' and the correct text.
steps.feedbackWrong: The paragraph with class 'negative-letter-spacing' is missing or incorrect. Review the instruction.

steps.title: Add negative word-spacing example
steps.instruction: Add a CSS rule for a class named 'negative-word-spacing' that sets word-spacing to -3px.
steps.hint: Create a new CSS selector that targets the class 'negative-word-spacing' and apply the word-spacing property with a negative value.
steps.expectedOutcome: A CSS rule is added that demonstrates negative word-spacing values.
successCriteria: The CSS contains a selector for '.negative-word-spacing' with 'word-spacing: -3px' property.
steps.feedbackCorrect: Great! You've successfully added a negative word-spacing example. This shows how word-spacing can be reduced to bring words closer together.
steps.feedbackPartial: You're close! Make sure you're targeting the class 'negative-word-spacing' and using the exact value '-3px' for the word-spacing property.
steps.feedbackWrong: The CSS rule for negative word-spacing wasn't added correctly. Check that you're using the correct class name and property value.

steps.title: Add descriptive labels and final styling
steps.instruction: Add heading elements (h2) above each example paragraph to label them clearly, and apply final styling to improve presentation.
steps.hint: Add <h2> elements with descriptive text like 'Letter-Spacing Example', 'Word-Spacing Example', etc. Then add CSS rules to style these headings and adjust margins/padding for better visual separation.
steps.expectedOutcome: The page will have clear section labels for each example (letter-spacing, word-spacing, normal text, negative examples) and improved visual presentation with proper spacing and styling.
successCriteria: Heading elements (h2) are added above each example paragraph with descriptive text. CSS rules are added to style the headings and improve overall page presentation (e.g., body padding, margins, font styling).
steps.feedbackCorrect: Great! You've successfully added clear labels to each example and improved the overall presentation with final styling. The demonstration is now complete and educational.
steps.feedbackPartial: You've added some labels or styling, but not all required elements. Make sure to add h2 headings for each example (letter-spacing, word-spacing, normal text, negative examples) and apply final presentation styling.
steps.feedbackWrong: The required headings and final styling are missing. Add h2 elements with descriptive labels above each example paragraph, and add CSS rules to style these headings and improve page presentation.
